input: Research private school options for next fall

gold.taskTitle: Research Private School Options for Next Fall
gold.taskDescription: Research and evaluate private school options for a child enrolling in the upcoming fall semester.

questions.title: What grade will your child be entering next fall?
questions.description: Identify the specific grade level to narrow school options appropriately.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the schools be in?
questions.description: Determine the geographic area or commute radius for the school search.

questions.title: What is your target annual tuition budget?
questions.description: Establish a financial range to filter schools that are realistically affordable.

questions.title: Do you prefer a specific academic or religious philosophy?
questions.description: Clarify any preference for curriculum style, such as Montessori, classical, faith-based, or college-prep.

questions.title: Are there specific programs or extracurriculars that matter most?
questions.description: Identify must-have offerings such as arts, athletics, STEM, or language programs.

questions.title: Does your child have any learning or support needs to consider?
questions.description: Understand whether specialized support services, accommodations, or learning environments are required.

questions.title: How many schools are you aiming to apply to?
questions.description: Define the scope of the research to know whether this is a broad survey or a short, targeted list.
